title: Dataverse: build solutions with coding agents using the Dataverse plugin and Work IQ
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets, administrator paths, client-update API and billing statements are supported. Some reference titles still describe business skills and Work IQ administration articles as preview even though those articles no longer carry that designation.

claims.claim: Dataverse MCP requires tenant administrator consent.
claims.quote: A tenant administrator grants consent to the MCP client application.

claims.claim: Dataverse MCP client applications must be allowed in each target environment.

claims.claim: Other plugin tools such as the Python SDK and Power Platform CLI authenticate directly.
claims.quote: Other tools used by the plugin, such as the Dataverse SDK for Python and Power Platform CLI, authenticate directly

claims.claim: The plugin's directly authenticated tools are not subject to the MCP-specific consent and client controls.
claims.quote: Other tools used by the plugin, such as the Dataverse SDK for Python and Power Platform CLI, authenticate directly and aren't subject to these MCP-specific controls.

claims.claim: Requests from directly authenticated tools still require Dataverse authorization.
claims.quote: Their requests still require Dataverse authorization.

claims.claim: Business skills require Work IQ to be enabled for their environment.
claims.quote: A Dataverse environment with Work IQ enabled by a Power Platform administrator.

claims.claim: Business Applications in Work IQ is on by default for new public production environments, subject to exceptions.
claims.quote: Business Applications in Work IQ is on by default for new public production environments created for new or existing tenants. The following environments are exceptions:

claims.claim: EU and EFTA environments are exceptions to Work IQ default enablement.
claims.quote: European Union (EU) and European Free Trade Association (EFTA) environments: This exception applies to environments provisioned in the EU and EFTA macro region geography.

claims.claim: Government-related environments are exceptions to Work IQ default enablement.
claims.quote: Government-related environments: This exception applies to environments provisioned by customers with current or previous government cloud deployments that are likely to depend on FedRAMP security controls.

claims.claim: Trial, sandbox and developer environments are exceptions to Work IQ default enablement.
claims.quote: Nonproduction environments: This exception applies to trial, sandbox, and developer environments.

claims.claim: Microsoft deferred the previously documented November 2026 default-enablement schedule for existing environments.
claims.quote: The plan to turn on Business Applications in Work IQ for existing environments that aren't listed as exceptionshas been deferred from the previously documented November 2026 schedule. Check this article for updates.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a replacement default-enablement date for existing environments.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Applications in Work IQ" "existing environments" "deferred" schedule. Opened default-settings in full; it defers November 2026 and says to check for updates, without a replacement date.

claims.claim: Work IQ environment enablement is separate from installing the optional Dataverse coding plugin.
claims.quote: Install the plugin for your coding agent.

claims.claim: Disabling the tenant setting stops sharing between Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Dataverse even when an app is configured to share.
claims.quote: If you turn off this setting, data isn't shared between Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Dataverse, even if an app is configured to share data.

claims.claim: Work IQ participation settings are not a universal block and do not prevent agentic access to environment data.
claims.quote: These participation settings don't prevent agentic access to environment data. Use App Access controls to manage that access.

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP availability control applies to the entire server, independently of Copilot audience settings.
claims.quote: This control applies to the entire Work IQ MCP server, separate from Copilot audience settings or App Access.

claims.quote: An MCP client that is allowed to talk to MCP endpoint; Primary key: allowedmcpclientid; isenabled | Edm.Boolean | Display name: Is Enabled

claims.claim: The plugin includes guidance for administration tasks and supported environment-setting changes.

claims.claim: Business skills can be shared through general access, Dataverse security roles or direct access.
claims.quote: You can provide access to a business skill in three ways: General access ... Security role access ... Direct access

claims.claim: Security-role-based skill sharing requires both Skill Sharing Role and the security role with which the skill is shared.
claims.quote: Security role access requires users to have two roles. An administrator must assign users the Skill Sharing Role, either directly or through a team. Users must also have the security role that the skill is shared with.

claims.claim: The coding plugin is user-opt-in: a developer chooses to install and use it, subject to existing access controls.
claims.quote: Install the plugin for your coding agent. ... After installation, ask your coding agent: Connect to my Dataverse environment.
